[LSTR.4.3] Indexing a `Bytes` value by integer position returns
the octet at that position as `Int` in `[0, 255]`.

Out-of-range and negative indices follow [LSTR.2.2]: an out-of-range index
raises a `ComputationError` and abandons the activation; a negative index is a
compile error when literal and a `ComputationError` when computed. `len(b)` is
the guard.
